heading: Activities
lead: In cooperation with appropriate State and local government authorities, each Federal land management agency shall plan for and carry out activities on Carl Garner Federal Lands Cleanup Day that—

tree.text: encourage continuing public and private sector cooperation in preserving the beauty and safety of areas within the jurisdiction of the agency;
increase citizens’ sense of ownership and community pride in those areas;
reduce litter on Federal lands, along trails and waterways, and within those areas; and
maintain and improve trails, recreation areas, waterways, and facilities.
